jobs.description: Number of jobslots. Accepts integer, percentage (e.g., '50%'), or math expression.

keep_order.description: If true, outputs are printed in the same order as input.

verbose.description: If true, prints the command to stderr before execution.

max_chars.description: Maximum command line length. Can include suffixes like '2M'. Leave empty for system default.

memfree.description: Minimum free memory. Can include suffixes like '1G'. Leave empty for no limit.

remote_profile.description: Name of the profile file in ~/.parallel/ to use for remote SSH jobs.

delay.description: Delay before starting next job. Can include suffixes like '0.1s' or 'auto'.

null_delimiter.description: If true, uses NUL character as input delimiter.

progress.description: If true, shows progress bars and statistics.

eta.description: If true, shows estimated time of arrival.

retries.description: Number of retries for failed jobs. 0 means no retries.

shell.description: Explicit shell to use for jobs. Leave empty to use default.
